#Description of analyses
#This analysis includes geometric morphometric multivariate ordinal and statistical analyses of large macropod calcanea .

##Load required packages
```{r}

install.packages(c("geomorph", "rgl", "Morpho", "plyr", "tidyverse", "caret","nlme", "doParallel", "gdata", "ggbeeswarm"))

library(geomorph)
library(rgl)
library(Morpho)
library(plyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(nlme)
library(doParallel)
library(gdata)
library(ggbeeswarm)

```

##Import Data
```{r Import Training Sample}
#open specifier file
speclist.train<- read.csv("Calcaneus/Data/Specifier.csv", header = TRUE)
rownames(speclist.train) <- c(paste(substr(speclist.train$Genus,1,1),substr(speclist.train$Species,1,3), speclist.train$Specimen_ID ,sep = "_"))

#Create vector of coordinate files
filelist.train <-list.files(path = "Calcaneus/Data/Coordinates", pattern = ".txt")

#Create vector of abbreviated specimen names
filelist_species <- rownames(speclist.train) 

#Create array of landmark coordinate data
coords <- NULL
for (i in seq_along(filelist.train)) {
  temp <- read.morphologika(
    file.path("Calcaneus", "Data", "Coordinates", filelist.train[i])
  ) 
  k <- dim(temp)[1] 
  coords <- rbind(coords, two.d.array(temp))}
Data.train <- arrayspecs(coords, k, 3) 
dimnames(Data.train)[[3]] <- c(paste(substr(speclist.train$Genus,1,1),substr(speclist.train$Species,1,3), speclist.train$Specimen_ID ,sep = "_"))

remove(i, k, coords, temp, filelist.train, filelist_species) 
```

```{r Clean Data}
Data.train <- Data.train[-c(9, 30),,] #remove undesired landmarks
```

```{r Set sliding semilandmarks}
slide <- c(31, 34:39, 42:47)
before <- slide - 1
after <- slide + 1
curves <- cbind(before, slide, after)
remove(before, slide, after)
```

```{r read in mesh file to check against}
Mgig <- read.ply("Calcaneus/Data/M_gig_QM-JM20893.ply")
Mgig$material$color <- Mgig$it
Mgig$material$color <- "light grey"
rgl.close()
shade3d(Mgig)
```

```{r check what order ply specimen in is data array}
dimnames(Data.train)[[3]]
```

```{r check landmarks against mesh}
plot3d(Data.train[,,15], asp=FALSE, size =5, col="green") #Data.train[,,x] where x is order of ply in array
text3d(Data.train[,,15], texts=c(1:dim (Data.train[,,15])[[1]])) #Data.train[,,x] where x is order of ply in array
shade3d(Mgig)
```

```{r check order of array}
#Double check that the order of your 3D array and the specifier list are the same for symbolising your plots later
#This has to return "TRUE" for all.

dimnames(Data.train)[[3]]==rownames(speclist.train)
```


##GPA
```{r Generalised Procrustes Analysis----}
#Remove effects of size, rotation and translation from landmark coordinates
GPA <- gpagen(Data.train, curves = curves)
#combine transformed coordinates and specifier list}
GPA <- geomorph.data.frame(GPA, genus = speclist.train$Genus, species = speclist.train$Species, ID = speclist.train$Specimen_ID, age = speclist.train$Age)
```


##Symbology
```{r Symbology}
Macropus <- "#E06120"
Osphranter <- "#53f395"
Notamacropus <- "#003eff"
Wallabia <- "#F9438F"

agilis <- "#003eff"
antilopinus <- "#1f986c"
bernardus <- "#93dd4b"
bicolor <- "#F9438F"
fuliginosus <- "#E29900"
giganteus <- "#E06120"
parryi <- "#191e86"
robustus <- "#53f395"
rufogriseus <- "#47e0ff"
rufus <- "#37671d"

age <- speclist.train$Age
age <- (gsub("Juvenile", 8, age))
age <- (gsub("Subadult", 17, age))
age <- (gsub("Adult", 16, age))
age <- ifelse(is.na(age), 7, age)
age <- as.numeric(age)
age

sex <- speclist.train$Sex
sex <- (gsub("Female", 17, sex))
sex <- (gsub("Male", 15, sex))
sex <- ifelse(is.na(sex), 16, sex)
sex <- as.numeric(sex)
sex
```


##Size
```{r Boxplot}
Csize <- cbind(speclist.train[,1:8], GPA$Csize)
colnames(Csize)[9] <- "Csize"

col <- c(bicolor, agilis, bernardus, rufogriseus, parryi, robustus, fuliginosus, rufus, giganteus, antilopinus)

ggplot(Csize, aes(x = reorder(Species, Csize), y = Csize, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(varwidth = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus, bicolor, fuliginosus, giganteus, parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Centroid Size")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

remove(Csize, col)
```


##Principal Components Analysis
```{r Plot PC1 and PC2}
PCA <- gm.prcomp(GPA$coords)
s_PCA <- summary(PCA)

chull <- cbind(speclist.train, PCA$x[,1:2])
colnames(chull)[9:10] <- c("PC1", "PC2")
polys <- ddply(chull, .(Species), function(chull) chull[chull(chull$PC1, chull$PC2), ])

palette <- c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus, bicolor, fuliginosus, giganteus, parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(speclist.train$Species)]

plot(PCA$x[,2] ~ PCA$x[,1], 
     pch=age,
     col=palette,
     xlab= paste("PC 1 (", round(s_PCA$PC.summary$Comp1[3]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""), 
     ylab= paste("PC 2 (", round(s_PCA$PC.summary$Comp2[2]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""), 
     main= paste("PCA of Macropod Calcaneus Shape (",round(s_PCA$PC.summary$Comp2[3]*100), "% variation)"),
     asp= FALSE, 
     cex=2.2)

polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="agilis"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="agilis"]), col = alpha(agilis, 0.2), border = agilis)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), col = alpha(antilopinus, 0.2), border = antilopinus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), col = alpha(bernardus, 0.2), border = bernardus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), col = alpha(bicolor, 0.2), border = bicolor)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), col = alpha(fuliginosus, 0.2), border = fuliginosus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), col = alpha(giganteus, 0.2), border = giganteus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="robustus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="robustus"]), col = alpha(robustus, 0.2), border = robustus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), col = alpha(rufogriseus, 0.2), border = rufogriseus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufus"]), col = alpha(rufus, 0.2), border = rufus)

abline(v=0, lty=2, col="grey50")
abline(h=0, lty=2, col="grey50")
remove(chull, polys)
```

```{r Plot PCA in 3D}
plot3d(PCA$x[,1], PCA$x[,2], PCA$x[,3],
       xlab = "PC1",
       ylab = "PC2",
       zlab = "PC3",
       col = palette,
       size = 1.7,
       aspect = FALSE,
       type = "s")
```


##Between Group PCA
```{r between group PCAs}
groups <- GPA$genus
bgPCA <- groupPCA(GPA$coords, groups = groups, cv = T)

palette <- c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus, bicolor, fuliginosus, giganteus, parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(speclist.train$Species)]

plot(bgPCA$Scores[,2] ~ bgPCA$Scores[,1], 
     pch=age,
     col= palette,
     xlab= paste("PC 1 (", round(bgPCA$Variance$exVar[1]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""),
     ylab= paste("PC 2 (", round(bgPCA$Variance$exVar[2]*100, 1), "%)", sep = ""), 
     asp=1, 
     cex=2.5,
     main = paste("bg-PCA of Macropod Calcaneus Shape grouped by Genus (",round(bgPCA$Variance$cumVar[2]*100), "% variation)"))

chull <- cbind(speclist.train, bgPCA$Scores[,1:2])
colnames(chull)[9:10] <- c("PC1", "PC2")
polys <- ddply(chull, .(Species), function(chull) chull[chull(chull$PC1, chull$PC2), ])

polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="agilis"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="agilis"]), col = alpha(agilis, 0.2), border = agilis)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="antilopinus"]), col = alpha(antilopinus, 0.2), border = antilopinus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bernardus"]), col = alpha(bernardus, 0.2), border = bernardus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="bicolor"]), col = alpha(bicolor, 0.2), border = bicolor)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="fuliginosus"]), col = alpha(fuliginosus, 0.2), border = fuliginosus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="giganteus"]), col = alpha(giganteus, 0.2), border = giganteus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="robustus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="robustus"]), col = alpha(robustus, 0.2), border = robustus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufogriseus"]), col = alpha(rufogriseus, 0.2), border = rufogriseus)
polygon(c(polys$PC1[polys$Species=="rufus"]), c(polys$PC2[polys$Species=="rufus"]), col = alpha(rufus, 0.2), border = rufus)


abline(v=0, lty=2, col="grey50")
abline(h=0, lty=2, col="grey50")

remove(chull, polys)
```

```{r Plot3d bg-PCA}
 plot3d(bgPCA$Scores[,1], bgPCA$Scores[,2], bgPCA$Scores[,3],
        xlab = "PC1",
        ylab = "PC2",
        zlab = "PC3",
        col = palette,
        size = 1.7,
        aspect = FALSE,
        type = "s")
```


##Allometry
```{r Allometry}
#remove Wallabia c(78:80) due to small sample size
AllomGenus1 <- procD.lm(GPA$coords[,,-c(78:80)] ~ GPA$Csize[-c(78:80)] + GPA$genus[-c(78:80)], logsz = TRUE, iter = 999, turbo = TRUE, RRPP = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE)
summary(AllomGenus1)

palette <- c(agilis, antilopinus, bernardus, fuliginosus, giganteus, parryi, robustus, rufogriseus, rufus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(GPA$species[-c(78:80)])]

tmp <- plotAllometry(AllomGenus1, GPA$Csize[-c(78:80)],
              logsz=TRUE,
              method = "RegScore",
              col = palette,
              pch= age[-c(78:80)],
              cex= 2,
              main = "Astragalus Intergenera Allometry")
lmData <- data.frame(cbind(tmp$plot.args$y, tmp$plot.args$x))
lmData$Genus <- GPA$genus[-c(78:80)]
colnames(lmData) <- c("RegScore", "Predictor", "Genus")
slopes <- coef(lmList(RegScore ~ Predictor|Genus, data = lmData))
remove(lmData)
abline(slopes[1,1], slopes[1,2], col = Macropus)
abline(slopes[2,1], slopes[2,2], col = Notamacropus)
abline(slopes[3,1], slopes[3,2], col = Osphranter)
remove(slopes, tmp)

```
 
```{r Unique Allometries}
#remove Wallabia c(78:80) due to small sample size
AllomGenus2 <- procD.lm(GPA$coords[,,-c(78:80)] ~ GPA$Csize[-c(78:80)] * GPA$genus[-c(78:80)],logsz = TRUE, iter = 999, turbo = TRUE, RRPP = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE)
summary(AllomGenus2)

tmp <- plotAllometry(AllomGenus2, GPA$Csize[-c(78:80)],
              logsz=TRUE,
              method = "RegScore",
              col = palette,
              pch= age[-c(78:80)],
              cex= 2,
              main = "Astragalus Intergenera Allometry w. Interaction")
lmData <- data.frame(cbind(tmp$plot.args$y, tmp$plot.args$x))
lmData$Genus <- GPA$genus[-c(78:80)]
colnames(lmData) <- c("RegScore", "Predictor", "Genus")
slopes <- coef(lmList(RegScore ~ Predictor|Genus, data = lmData))
remove(lmData)
abline(slopes[1,1], slopes[1,2], col = Macropus)
abline(slopes[2,1], slopes[2,2], col = Notamacropus)
abline(slopes[3,1], slopes[3,2], col = Osphranter)
remove(slopes, tmp)

slopepairwise <- pairwise(AllomGenus2, fit.null = AllomGenus1, groups = GPA$genus[-c(78:80)], covariate = log(GPA$Csize[-c(78:80)]))
summary(slopepairwise, type.test = "VC", confidence = 0.95, stat.table = TRUE)
```


##Visualising Taxonomic Shape Differences
```{r Calculating average shape & reference mesh}
#calculate GPA coordinates for average shape across dataset
MeanCoords <- mshape(GPA$coords) 

#find closest specimen to the mean shape & read ply
findMeanSpec(GPA$coords) 
MeanMesh <- read.ply("Calcaneus/Data/M_gig_QM-JM20893.ply") 

#save average specimen coordinates
mean_spec_coord <- Data.train[,,which(dimnames(Data.train)[[3]]=="M_gig_QM-JM20893")] 

#Warp a reference mesh for visualisations
WarpedRefMesh <- warpRefMesh(mesh = MeanMesh, mesh.coord= mean_spec_coord,  ref= MeanCoords, color = "light grey")
remove(MeanMesh)
```

```{r Warp Reference Meshes to Mean Genus Shapes in bgPCA}
#Predict mean genus shape in bgPCA
tmp <- bgPCA$Scores[,1:3]
preds <- shape.predictor(GPA$coords[,,], x= tmp, Intercept = FALSE,
                         Macropus = c(mean(tmp[1:18, 1]), mean(tmp[1:18,2]), mean(tmp[1:18,3])), #1
                         Notamacropus = c(mean(tmp[19:35, 1]), mean(tmp[19:35,2]), mean(tmp[19:35,3])), #2
                         Osphranter = c(mean(tmp[c(36:63), 1]), mean(tmp[c(36:63),2]), mean(tmp[c(36:63),3])), #3
                         Orufus = c(mean(tmp[c(64:77), 1]), mean(tmp[c(64:77),2]), mean(tmp[c(64:77),3])), #4
                         Wallabia = c(mean(tmp[78:80, 1]), mean(tmp[78:80,2]), mean(tmp[78:80,3]))) #5
#Warp reference meshes
meshlist <- list()
for (i in 1: length(preds)) {
  tempmesh <- plotRefToTarget(MeanCoords,
                              preds[[i]],
                              mesh = WarpedRefMesh,
                              method="surface")
  meshlist[[i]] <- tempmesh
}
remove(tmp, i, tempmesh)
```

##Visualising Intrageneric Allometry
```{r Osphranter}
#regress Shape ~ Csize for all Osphranter specimens except O. rufus
OsphAllom <- procD.lm(GPA$coords[,,36:63] ~ GPA$Csize[36:63], logsz = TRUE, iter = 999, turbo = TRUE, RRPP = TRUE, print.progress = FALSE)
summary(OsphAllom)

palette <- c(antilopinus, bernardus, robustus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(GPA$species[c(36:63)])]

#Plot Allometric Regression
OsphAllom.Plot <- plotAllometry(OsphAllom, GPA$Csize[36:63],
              logsz=TRUE,
              method = "PredLine",
              col = palette,
              pch= age[36:63],
              cex= 2,
              main = "Astragalus Intergenera Allometry")

#Predict Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
OsphPreds <- shape.predictor(OsphAllom$GM$fitted,
                             x= OsphAllom.Plot$PredLine,
                             Intercept = FALSE,
                             predmin = min(OsphAllom.Plot$PredLine),
                             predmax = max(OsphAllom.Plot$PredLine))

#Warp Reference Mesh to Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
SmallOsph <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords),
                OsphPreds$predmax,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

LargeOsph <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords),
                OsphPreds$predmin,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

#Visualize heat mapped vector displacement between corresponding landmarks 
differences <- coordinates.difference(coordinates = OsphPreds$predmax,
                                      reference = OsphPreds$predmin, type = "spherical")
procrustes.var.plot(OsphPreds$predmax, OsphPreds$predmin, col = heat.colors, col.val = differences[[1]][1:48], magnitude = 1, pt.size = 1) # 48 = n lmks
shade3d(LargeOsph, alpha = 0.6)

#Save image stack to make warp movie of allometric shape change from different aspects
#warpmovie3d(SmallOsph, LargeOsph, n = 15, palindrome = F, col = "lightgrey", folder = "Analyses/GIFs/Ontogeny", movie = "OsphranterOntogeny##AspectHere")
```

```{r Notamacropus}
summary(NmacAllom)

#Plot Allometric Regression
palette <- c(agilis, parryi, rufogriseus)
palette <- palette[as.factor(GPA$species[19:35])]
NmacAllom.Plot <- plotAllometry(NmacAllom, GPA$Csize[19:35],
              logsz=TRUE,
              method = "PredLine",
              col = palette,
              pch= age[19:35],
              cex= 2,
              main = "Astragalus Notamacropus Allometry")

#Predict Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
NmacPreds <- shape.predictor(NmacAllom$GM$fitted,
                             x= NmacAllom.Plot$PredLine,
                             Intercept = FALSE,
                             predmin = min(NmacAllom.Plot$PredLine),
                             predmax = max(NmacAllom.Plot$PredLine))

#Warp Reference Mesh to Min & Max Shapes along fitted allometric slope
SmallNmac <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords),
                NmacPreds$predmax,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

LargeNmac <- plotRefToTarget(mshape(GPA$coords),
                NmacPreds$predmin,
                method = "surface",
                mesh = WarpedRefMesh)

#Visualise heat mapped vector displacement between corresponding landmarks 
differences <- coordinates.difference(coordinates = NmacPreds$predmax,
                                      reference = NmacPreds$predmin, type = "spherical")
procrustes.var.plot(NmacPreds$predmax, NmacPreds$predmin, col = heat.colors, col.val = differences[[1]][1:48], magnitude = 1, pt.size = 1) # 48 = n lmks
shade3d(LargeNmac, alpha = 0.6)

#Save image stack to make warp movie of allometric shape change from different aspects
#warpmovie3d(SmallNmac, LargeNmac, n = 15, palindrome = F, col = "lightgrey", folder = "Analyses/GIFs/Ontogeny", movie = "NotamacropusOntogeny##AspectHere")
```

```{r Linear Discriminant Analysis - Optimise No. Predictors}

#Create empty matrix for optimising predictors 
IterativePCA <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = 3))
colnames(IterativePCA) <- c("k", "Accuracy", "Kappa")

# Generalised Procrustes Analysis
GPA <- gpagen(Data.train, curves = curves)

# Convert Procrustes coordinates to 2D matrix
coords <- two.d.array(GPA$coords)

#run loop to save Accuracy & Kappa scores in stepwise addition of PCs as predictors 
set.seed(42)
for (i in 2:16) { #2:x where x is number of PCs in PCA, limited to 16 in LDA to ensure the number of predictors does not exceed the within-class sample size 
ldaFIT <- train(x = coords, 
                    y = speclist.train$Genus,
                    method = "lda",
                    metric = "Accuracy",
                    prior = c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
                    preProcess = "pca",
                    trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", 
                                             preProcOptions = list(pcaComp = i), 
                                             classProbs = TRUE))

IterativePCA <- rbind(IterativePCA, ldaFIT$results[which.max(ldaFIT$results$Accuracy),])} #Save Accuracy and Kappa scores in dataframe to assess optimal PCs

#plot Accuracy & Kappa scores to determine optimal number of PCs to include as predictors in model
IterativePCA$PCs <- c(2:16)
tmp <- IterativePCA[,c(3,4)]
tmp$Group <- c("Kappa")
ldaPlot <- IterativePCA[,c(2,4)]
ldaPlot$Group <- c("Accuracy")
colnames(ldaPlot)[1] <- "Score"
colnames(tmp)[1] <- "Score"
ldaPlot <- rbind(ldaPlot, tmp)
remove(tmp)

ggplot(ldaPlot, aes(x=PCs, y=Score, group = Group, color = Group)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point()+
  labs(title = "LDA", x = "No. principal components", y = "Overall model accuracy & kappa scores")

print(IterativePCA %>% 
  arrange(-Accuracy) %>% 
  head(5))

```

```{r Linear Discriminant Analysis - Final Model}
# adjust predictors to optimal number of PCs and rerun final model
set.seed(42)

ldaFIT <- train(x = coords, 
                    y = speclist.train$Genus,
                    method = "lda",
                    metric = "Accuracy",
                    prior = c(0.25, 0.25, 0.25, 0.25),
                    preProcess = "pca", #nest PCA inside LOOCV loop
                    trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", 
                                             preProcOptions = list(pcaComp = 9), 
                                             classProbs = TRUE))

#2) Summary of final model
ldaFIT

#2) Confusion matrix of final model
confusionMatrix(ldaFIT$pred$pred, ldaFIT$pred$obs)

```

```{r K Nearest Neighbour - Optimise No. Predictors}
#Create empty matrix for optimising predictors 
IterativePCA <- data.frame(matrix(nrow = 0, ncol = 3))
colnames(IterativePCA) <- c("k", "Accuracy", "Kappa")

# Generalised Procrustes Analysis
GPA <- gpagen(Data.train, curves = curves)

# Convert Procrustes coordinates to 2D matrix
coords <- two.d.array(GPA$coords)

#run loop to save Accuracy & Kappa scores in stepwise addition of PCs as predictors 
set.seed(42)

cl <- makePSOCKcluster(5)
registerDoParallel(cl)
for (i in 2:79) { #2:x where x is number of PCs in PCA
  knnTune <- train(x = coords, 
                 y = speclist.train$Genus,
                 method = "knn",
                 preProcess = "pca",
                 trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", 
                                             preProcOptions = list(pcaComp = i), 
                                             classProbs = TRUE))
  
IterativePCA <- rbind(IterativePCA, knnTune$results[which.max(knnTune$results$Accuracy),])} #Save Accuracy and Kappa scores in dataframe to assess optimal PCs
stopCluster(cl)

#plot Accuracy & Kappa scores to determine optimal number of PCs to include as predictors in model
IterativePCA$PCs <- c(2:79)
tmp <- IterativePCA[,c(1,3,4)]
tmp$Group <- c("Kappa")
knnPlot <- IterativePCA[,c(1,2,4)]
knnPlot$Group <- c("Accuracy")
colnames(knnPlot)[2] <- "Score"
colnames(tmp)[2] <- "Score"
knnPlot <- rbind(knnPlot, tmp)
remove(tmp)

ggplot(knnPlot, aes(x=PCs, y=Score, group = Group, color = Group)) + 
   geom_line() +
   geom_point()+
    labs(title = "kNN", x = "No. principal components", y = "Overall model accuracy & kappa scores")


print(IterativePCA %>% 
  arrange(-Accuracy) %>% 
  head(5))

```

```{r KNN - Tuning Final Model}
#adjust predictors to optimal number of PCs and rerun final model
set.seed(42)
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(5)
registerDoParallel(cl)
knnFit <- train(x = coords, 
                y = speclist.train$Genus, 
                method = "knn", 
                tuneGrid = data.frame(.k = c(7)), #tune k between c(3,5,7,9,11,13,15), then change to optimal k
                preProcess = "pca", #nest PCA inside LOOCV loop
                trControl = trainControl(method = "LOOCV", 
                                         preProcOptions = list(pcaComp = 18), 
                                         classProbs = T))
stopCluster(cl)

#Plot Accuracy score over k to determine optimal value for k
# plot(knnFit)

#Summary of final model
knnFit

#Confusion matrix of final model 
confusionMatrix(knnFit$pred$pred, knnFit$pred$obs)

```
